_comment: The committed legal theme set of the hypothesis-authoring agent.
app_spec.xml, Hypothesis Authoring Agent, feature 212:
System rejects a proposal whose theme root falls outside the
configured legal set, which returns an illegal_theme error message.
docs/alpha-engine-prd.md 9 ('Hypothesis space (the human's job)') is
where the set comes from and why it is committed rather than computed:
'Dream-RSI improves search efficiency within a space. It cannot create
edge in a space that has none. Choosing the space is the highest-value
human input in the system, and it should be encoded as the set of legal
theme_root values.'  Section 9.3 lists the initial six; each entry
below carries that section's name for it verbatim as its title, so the
document and the PRD can be diffed against each other by eye.
Section 9.4 is the neighbouring refusal and NOT this one: 'structurally
dead at retail scale' - triangular arbitrage, sub-30-minute
liquidity-taking - is feature 213's subject, and it is a different
question about a root that is already inside this set.  A theme the
human admitted and a mechanism that cannot pay for itself are two
findings, and a document that folded them together would make the
second unfixable without widening the first.
The compile in packages/signal-agent/src/signal_agent/_themes.py
refuses this file and any change to it that is not a marker plus a
list of well-formed slug/title entries - so the set below is not a
convention the next edit can forget: it is the configuration, checked,
and a proposal opening in a theme it does not name is refused with the
code illegal_theme.
The slugs are the machine spelling the node table's theme_root column
holds (docs/nullius-tech-architecture.md 9.1: 'theme_root TEXT NOT
NULL'); the titles are for the human reading a rejection.  Widening
this list is widening the hypothesis space, which PRD 9 makes the
human's own decision - the widen happens here, in review, or not at
all.
